metadata.title: Sechszirbenhütte at Falkert | Premium Mountain Retreat in the Nockberge
metadata.description: Historic mountain cabin with sauna in secluded location at 1,800m. Hiking, skiing & relaxation in Carinthia. Families & dogs welcome. Book now!

hero.title: at the Sechszirbenhütte
hero.subtitle: Premium mountain retreat at 1,800m in the Carinthian Nockberge
hero.description: Experience unforgettable vacation days in our over 250-year-old mountain cabin – lovingly restored, with a sauna annex and in complete seclusion amidst Swiss stone pine and larch forests at Falkert.

altitude.title: 1,800m Altitude
altitude.description: Alpine panorama with views to the Karawanken mountains

secluded.title: Secluded Location
secluded.description: Absolute tranquility amidst Swiss stone pine and larch forests

sauna.title: Sauna & Wellness
sauna.description: Private sauna annex with relaxation room and rain shower

guests.title: Up to 5 Guests
guests.description: Ideal for families and small groups

heidiAlm.title: Heidi Alm Mountain Resort: Close to Heaven, Far from Everyday Life
heidiAlm.description: Experience an unforgettable vacation at the Heidi Alm Mountain Resort, surrounded by healthy mountain air, crystal-clear mountain water, and colorful alpine nature. Discover gentian, alpine roses, and edelweiss – and with a bit of luck, marmots in their natural habitat.

winter.title: Winter Vacation at Heidi-Alm
winter.description: The family-friendly ski resort offers three lifts, a magic carpet, and varied slopes for beginners to advanced skiers.

activities.skiSchool: Peter's ski school for children and adults

ferienhaus.title: The Sechszirbenhütte – Rustic Romance with Modern Comfort
ferienhaus.intro: Treat yourself to an unforgettable cabin vacation in our over 250-year-old mountain cabin in secluded location – right at the Nockberge National Park and just 800m from the picturesque Falkertsee.

umgebung.title: Year-Round Vacation Destination for the Whole Family
umgebung.subtitle: Southern Austria: Skiing & Nature Vacation in Perfect Climate
umgebung.intro: Discover the idyllic ski village of Falkertsee in southern Austria, where ski and nature enthusiasts find perfect climate conditions. Experience from December to April dream-like snow conditions and in summer lush green meadows in Carinthia's highest ski village.

central.title: Sechszirbenhütte: Central Accommodation for All Activities
central.description: The Sechszirbenhütte is the ideal accommodation for your vacation in Falkertsee. Thanks to its central location, you have easy access to all ski areas, hiking trails, the Nockberge National Park, and the picturesque Carinthian lakes.

nationalpark.title: Nockberge National Park & Adjacent Ski Areas
nationalpark.description: Explore the impressive Nockberge National Park in close proximity to the Sechszirbenhütte. Also benefit from the proximity to the excellent ski areas of Turracher Höhe and Bad Kleinkirchheim for even more variety.

dreilaendereck.title: Three-Country Corner: Italy, Slovenia & Austria
dreilaendereck.description: The central location of the Sechszirbenhütte allows you to conveniently explore the three-country corner of Italy, Slovenia, and Austria and discover the cultural highlights of the region.

activities.title: Year-Round Activities for the Whole Family
activities.description: No matter the season, there are numerous activities for the whole family around the Sechszirbenhütte. Experience unforgettable moments skiing, hiking, golfing, or visiting the picturesque Carinthian lakes.

heidiAlm.title: Heidi-Alm, Golfing, Hiking & More
heidiAlm.description: Explore the diverse mountain world around the Sechszirbenhütte or use the golf opportunities (18-hole) in Bad Kleinkirchheim. The famous Heidi-Alm especially attracts young visitors to the mountain.

kaerntenCard.title: Save with the Kärnten Card
kaerntenCard.description: Learn about the attractive Kärnten Card, with which you can save a lot of money during your stay. Especially great for families – it usually pays for itself after the 2nd gondola ride.

dogTrips.title: The 5 Most Beautiful Trips with Dogs in Carinthia

trips.title: Falkert and Falkertsee
trips.description: A walk around the Falkertsee is a fixed part of our stay on the mountain and is also manageable for older dogs. A hike to the Falkert is also a must. Depending on fitness, it takes 1 to 3 hours. A steep or moderate ascent and descent are possible. The dog should be mountain-experienced and fit.

trips.title: Hike Rodresnock/Moschelitzen/Marmot Valley
trips.description: An extensive, partly sporty and mostly quite windy circular hike. Our secret favorite – often you don't meet a soul and have the Nockberge to yourself.

trips.title: Three Lakes Hike at Turracher Höhe
trips.description: A moderate hike along the three lakes. Suitable for all levels. Easy to reach by car. Be sure to stop by the Karl-Hütte for Kaiserschmarrn.

trips.title: Panorama Trail Hochrindl
trips.description: Various hiking trails start from here, including a beautiful panorama hike with many fresh water opportunities. Perfect for dogs.

trips.title: Beach Tschinder at Millstätter See
trips.description: If you're looking for a cool-off in summer and want to bring your four-legged friend, head to Beach Tschinder at Millstätter See. There's an area for dogs, of course with leash!

kidsTrips.title: The 7 Most Beautiful Trips with Children in Carinthia

trips.title: Heidi-Alm at Falkert
trips.description: The Heidi-Alm at Falkert is just around the corner and offers a fairytale walk through the Heidi world with views of the surrounding mountains. A large slide and a modern playground complete the excursion.

trips.title: Turracher Höhe and Nocky-Flitzer
trips.description: The Turracher Höhe is a beautiful ski area for beginners and pros. Outside the winter season, the Alpine roller coaster Nockyflitzer is an absolute excursion highlight. From 3 years, it's a fast ride down the mountain.

trips.title: Ossiacher See and Familywald
trips.description: Lake Ossiach is about 30 minutes drive from the Sechszirbenhütte. Right next to it is the adventure and climbing forest Familywald. Here, small and big children get their money's worth.

trips.title: Panorama Trail St. Oswald (with Brunnachbahn)
trips.description: Our standard hike when we're at Falkert. Take the Brunnachbahn in Bad Kleinkirchheim to the Panorama Trail St. Oswald. The hike is kid-friendly and not too steep.

trips.title: Animal Park Feld am See
trips.description: The Alpine Animal Park Feld am See is a wildlife park at the foot of a mountain. Here you can observe various native animals as well as a small petting zoo. Two playgrounds provide variety.

trips.title: Mountain Railway Gerlitzen-Alpe
trips.description: The Gerlitzen-Alpe is a well-known starting point for paragliders. In good conditions, there's always a lot to marvel at. At the individual stations of the mountain railways, various playgrounds await.

trips.title: Panorama Road Nockalm
trips.description: The Nockberge have a unique beauty. Like warm green giants, the natural wonders lie in the landscape. They can be especially impressively admired on the Nockalm Panorama Road.

directions.title: Hiking – Winter Sports – Relaxation: How to Find Us
directions.description: Coming from the Tauern motorway A10, take the exit Spittal/Millstätter See and drive east along the lake to Radenthein. There, at the roundabout at the town exit, take the direction towards Bad Kleinkirchheim. Drive through Bad Kleinkirchheim and after about 2 km at the next intersection turn left towards Turrach and Falkertsee. After about 500 m, a Heidi figure shows the mountain road up (about 8 km) to Falkertsee. In the village you will find signposts with the corresponding house numbers.
directions.note: For car access from November to April, snow chains should be in your luggage.
